notes.title: Behind the Frame and The Star Named EOS Physical Switch to be Released in Japan
notes.content:
Two stories by Silver Lining Studio in one package!

Behind the Frame and The Star Named EOS, two adventure games by the critically acclaimed Taiwanese indie game studio Silver Lining Studio, will be released together as a set in a special physical edition for the Nintendo Switch.

[previewyoutube=jgcOat30ZJQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Both are games where you can interact with a gorgeous hand-drawn world with panorama technology to solve puzzles. Behind the Frame is themed around paintings, while The Star Named EOS is themed around photographs, but both are storytelling puzzle adventures that each feature a heartwarming story about the people you love.

The special physical edition that contains both Behind the Frame and The Star Named EOS will be released in Japan on August 7, 2025. Preorders are now open!

Please check the PLAYISM page for more information: https://playism.com/game/behindtheframe-thestarnamedeos/

notes.title: Behind the Frame Post-Launch Update
notes.content:
Hey, painters!

I come bearing updates for [i]Behind the Frame![/i] We’ve been tracking a ton of issues that folks have been reporting in the new update and we’ve got a bunch of fixes coming for folks. I’ve also seen a few common problems cropping up here and there that I’d like to broadcast some help for. 

But I would like to relay an exceptionally large [b]“Thank You!”[/b] from everyone at Silver Lining and Akupara Games. We have loved hearing how much everyone is enjoying the new DLC and it’s really humbling to see so many folks really with our game. 

Without further ado: 

[h2]New Free Content: The Jack Chapters[/h2]
A new story with new paintings and a new orange cat! 

For those who haven’t tuned in, The Jack Chapters are now live as a piece of free additional content for [i]Behind the Frame[/i]. One of the first things we heard from many players when they finished the game in 2021 was how intriguing the world and story of [i]Behind the Frame[/i] was. They wanted to know more, to explore more, to paint more and to solve more puzzles. So, now that it’s almost a year later, we’re happy to provide. 

If you’ve completed the game and have your save file, you can jump into this new content immediately after making sure you’ve updated to the latest version!  

As an aside, we’ve also brought [i]Behind the Frame[/i] to two new platforms in the Nintendo Switch and Playstation 4, so if you’re looking to re-experience the game on console, feel free to find us on either of those storefronts. 

[h2]Behind the Frame Bug Fixes:[/h2]
Some save data corruption points have been resolved. If you have corrupted save data and would like a replacement save, please check out the FAQ below!
The DLC button itself has been made more prominent
A multitude of minor bug fixes affecting niche scenarios. 

[h2]Common Problems for the DLC[/h2]
I’ve also been reading some of the common problems that have cropped up since we launched the DLC. I just wanted to help make sure folks can play, so here are some answers to Frequently Asked Questions: 

[h3]Where can I access the new DLC content?[/h3]
If you have the game updated and have completed all chapters of the base game, a small placard with the name “Jack” will populate under the left side of the screen. Hit that to access the new content!

[h3]What if I no longer have a completed save of the base game?[/h3]
I have one for you [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1BX0P7caydWSGGZipE3_-u0t3Zmg1w-jJ/view?usp=sharing]here![/url]

On Windows, you can find your [i]Behind the Frame[/i] folder in this location: %AppData\LocalLow\Silver Lining Studio\Behind the Frame

[h3]What if I’m getting weird issues on the cutscenes?[/h3]
We sometimes hear that the cutscenes aren’t triggering correctly for some players. A quick fix to this problem (especially on the Steam Deck) is to change the video codec in the settings menu. Changing from H.264 to VP8 tends to solve this. 

If there are any other questions or concerns, please feel free to leave a comment down below and I’ll be excited to see more.

notes.title: April 25th Development Update
notes.content:
Hey, painters!

For those of you looking curiously at the seven new achievements we let slip on Steam, [b]yes there’s new stuff coming to [i]Behind the Frame![/i][/b] I’ll have a little more detail on what that all entails in the not-too-distant future, but I did just want to state plainly and for the record: The new achievements aren’t completable (yet!) So, if you’re an achievement hunter thirsting after the coveted 100%, you’ll get there Soon™. 

I also want to take the opportunity to talk a bit about the game’s price. [b]On April 28th, you’ll see the base price for [i]Behind the Frame[/i] increase from $9.99 to $12.99.[/b] If you already own the game, don’t worry! This won’t affect you one bit. If you have the game on your wishlist, I’d recommend picking it up now before the price increases on April 28th.

To pull back the curtain on that decision a bit, we’ve talked internally a lot about the way we’d like to release the upcoming [i]Behind the Frame[/i] content in a way that felt fair for everyone, us, the developers and you guys. Ultimately, we decided it’d be best to release the new content for free while also increasing the base price of the game. Everyone will be able to play the new content the day it goes live if they own [i]Behind the Frame: The Finest Scenery[/i] - with no hassle outside of downloading the game or updating their current version. To reflect and respect the time and effort it took to develop the new content, we’re going to increase the base price of the game for any purchases after April 28th.

If you have any questions or concerns about the price increase or the new achievements, please feel free to ask! As always, I’ll try to answer all the questions I can. Otherwise, I hope you’re looking forward to the next juicy morsel of [i]Behind the Frame[/i] coming Soon™. 

-Buddy

notes.title: Behind the Frame Artbook, Soundtrack Bundle and Trading Cards Are Live Now!
notes.content:
Hey, artists!

We're dropping a ton of news all at once! We're releasing the [i]Behind the Frame[/i] art book, bundling it with the game and soundtrack, updating the game and putting out trading cards today. Here are the details!

[h3]Artbook[/h3]
Today, we're so excited to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1740520/Behind_the_Frame_The_Finest_Scenery__Art_Book/?beta=0]show off the Behind the Frame art book[/url] which includes detailed insights into the art, style and animation of [i]Behind the Frame[/i]. So much feedback from players has been about the game's beautiful design so the artbook is now available to share a little piece of that with you today. 

If you'd like to pick up everything [i]Behind the Frame[/i] in one big bundle, I'd recommend [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/22651/Behind_the_Frame__Deluxe_Edition/]clicking this link.[/url] It includes the art book, soundtrack and the game! 

[h3]Trading Cards[/h3]
Alongside the release of the art book, we have also set Behind the Frame trading cards live! There are now eight collectable (non-spoiler) cards that players who played should immediately receive and players in the future will receive. If you'd like to trade, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1634150/tradingforum/]head to the Steam Forums[/url] and try to find some matches!

[h3]Patches[/h3]
For those of you that have been paying close attention to [i]Behind the Frame[/i] the past few weeks, you'll have seen a number of patches hit to take care of problems cropping up. While we'd have loved the game to play flawlessly on every computer out there, the realities of indie game development sometimes mean we need to quickly and decisively react to issues that crop up. Thankfully, after the last few weeks of rapid patching, that process has drawn to a close. 

We'll still be updating the game and addressing bugs as they make it to us but the lion's share of major issues affecting Behind the Frame and its demo have been resolved. If you have any problems playing the game, feel free to post in the official discussion forums and I'd be happy to follow up with you!

--------------------------------------------------------------

That bring us to the end of the major announcements. Launching Behind the Frame has been an absolute treat and one of my favorite games to work on. Thank you so much for making the game a success!

notes.title: Complete Your Masterpiece in Behind the Frame Today!
notes.content:
Behind the Frame: The Finest Scenery is available now for $9.99 on PC and Mac with a 10% launch discount!

Uncover a passionate painter’s tale one brushstroke at a time in the multi-award-winning, interactive fiction! We have loved working with the incredibly talented team at Silver Lining Studio and co-publisher Akatsuki Taiwan to fully realize their heartfelt animated story. 

[previewyoutube=cRV6ajZLg6w;full][/previewyoutube]

An aspiring artist on the cusp of finishing the final piece of her gallery submission, Behind the Frame’s lush world gives you that slice of life calm you can hear in its soundtrack today. Guide her brush strokes and solve a variety of puzzles to help complete her masterpiece amid her brusque neighbor’s gaze and his pesky cat. As her painting takes shape, uncover an emotional tale of chance and artistry revealed behind unrelated yet familiar moments.

Features: 
[list]
[*] Paint, sketch, and retouch your artwork to complete your masterpiece and your memories
[*] Dive into and explore beautiful panoramic, hand-animated worlds inspired by Miyazaki/Studio Ghibli visuals
[*] Experience an evocative story, through the eyes of a passionate artist
[/list]

notes.title: Behind the Frame Arrives August 25th!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that Behind the Frame will be coming to Steam on August 25th, 2021!

A beautiful love letter to hand-drawn animation and heartfelt storytelling, we have been delighted to see the response to the game from each and every one of you and cannot wait for you to discover more in August. If you’d like to get a taste of Behind the Frame for yourself, we have a demo live on Steam for a limited time! The first chapter of the game will introduce you to its world, mechanics and characters, so it’s a perfect way to get acquainted before the game comes out in a few weeks!

[previewyoutube=X7_xvyKFAOY;full][/previewyoutube]

Features: 
Paint, sketch, and retouch your artwork to complete your masterpiece and your memories
Dive into and explore beautiful panoramic, hand-animated worlds inspired by Miyazaki/Studio Ghibli visuals
Experience an evocative story, through the eyes of a passionate artist

Behind the Frame is about an aspiring artist on the cusp of finishing the final piece of her gallery submission. Guide her brush strokes and solve a variety of puzzles to help complete her masterpiece; amid her brusque neighbor’s gaze and his pesky cat. As her painting starts to take shape, uncover an emotional tale of chance and artistry revealed behind unrelated yet familiar moments.
